rules.title: Berkeley security deposit interest
rules.requirement: Landlords of units covered by the Berkeley Rent Ordinance must pay tenants interest on the security deposit each year, prorated on move-out. The deposit cap (one month, or two for small owners, from July 1, 2024) is state law (AB 12), not local.
rules.key_value: interest due annually on deposits; cap itself is state law (1 month, 2 for small owners)
rules.coverage_conditions: Units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year. See our
rules.interaction: Deposit amount limits come from California law, not a Berkeley rule.

notes: Page is a summary; the interest requirement names only the Berkeley Rent Ordinance, so ch. 13.76 is the best citation (section not stated). Cap and return rules described are state law (AB 12).
